items.name: herdr-core
items.purpose: If you use the Herdr app (the desktop client of herdr-core), Hivemill can live inside it:

items.name: hivemill
items.purpose: Guided install of Hivemill over a deterministic, CI-tested installer.

items.name: hivemill-spend
items.purpose: See where your Claude tokens go across agents, and cap worker context while the boss keeps the big picture.

items.name: boss
items.purpose: the owner's single point of contact

skills.name: ci-wait
skills.purpose: Wait for PR CI in a background Bash task instead of foreground polling.

skills.name: go-change
skills.purpose: Checklist for writing idiomatic, safe, stdlib-only Go under go/ with tests and the local toolchain.

skills.name: guard-change
skills.purpose: Procedure for changing a guard so the PR fixes the whole bypass class and loosens nothing unplanned.

skills.name: pr-description
skills.purpose: Write a concrete, short PR body in the factory template (Summary, Why, Changes, Test evidence, Risk / rollback).

skills.name: pre-pr-check
skills.purpose: Self-check that catches the misses a reviewer or QA would otherwise find (unmet spec item, red CI, duplicate def, flaky test, missing PR-body item, unmeasured limit).

skills.name: self-review
skills.purpose: Independent read of your own diff by one fresh Sonnet subagent using the reviewer checklist, before in_review.

skills.name: stuck-and-finish
skills.purpose: Coder detail for a wrong or impossible spec, resource problems, and what factory done refuses.

skills.name: close-goal
skills.purpose: Director steps to sign off, close and reopen a goal after the pm audit.

skills.name: cycle-procedures
skills.purpose: Detail text moved out of director.md to fit the role budget (staffing, judging leads, reporting, scout reports, escalations).

skills.name: delivery
skills.purpose: How the director owns goal delivery (rules D1-D5, owner M7486): direct worker dispatch, per-goal delivery plan, daily delivery report with slips and recovery actions.

skills.name: lanes-and-holds
skills.purpose: Rules L1-L4 for file lanes and H1-H5 for judge holds (G-058, owner decision M37547).

skills.name: owner-decisions
skills.purpose: Decide what the director settles itself, what goes to the owner and what defaults after 2 daytime hours (owner standing rule M833).

skills.name: restriction-check
skills.purpose: List every automated writer of a target before proposing a restriction, and say how each is affected.

skills.name: utilization
skills.purpose: How to measure and raise worker utilization, check goal starvation and report the utilization line (director rules R1-R6, G-018).

items.name: lead
items.purpose: delivers one goal (or one scope of it)

skills.name: audit-round
skills.purpose: Goal-end audit procedure for the lead: audit task, pm spawn, gaps rounds, director sign-off.

skills.name: blocked-worker
skills.purpose: Answer a worker that is stuck on a permission dialog without changing the owner's settings.

skills.name: fix-loop
skills.purpose: Run retries, stalls and the third attempt on a task.

skills.name: park
skills.purpose: Hand your pane back with `factory park` while your next step is queued or the goal waits, and resume cleanly after a wake.

skills.name: pr-triage
skills.purpose: Find the real reason a PR is stuck or red before blaming CI.

skills.name: research-flow
skills.purpose: Run a research task from researcher to evidence review to the director's report.

skills.name: spec-change
skills.purpose: Change a running worker's spec, acceptance or scope safely through the task DB.

skills.name: worker-brief
skills.purpose: Checklist to run before every worker spawn so the brief is complete and safe.

skills.name: acceptance-template
skills.purpose: Make every acceptance item a runnable command with an expected result, quote wording exactly, and add a RISKS section.

skills.name: audit-checklist
skills.purpose: The pm goal-audit checklist: what to check per task, how to trace success criteria, how to act on gaps.

skills.name: audit-scope
skills.purpose: What the pm goal audit must not redo, so it stays a paper check of records.

skills.name: language-choice
skills.purpose: Pick and state the implementation language in a coder spec per the language-policy ADR.

skills.name: plan-quality
skills.purpose: Rules for plans, build tasks and acceptance criteria that touch shared contracts or guards.

skills.name: research-plan
skills.purpose: Plan a research goal or task as researcher tasks with a brief, numbered acceptance and an evidence-review task.

items.name: researcher
items.purpose: one research question, one evidence-backed report

skills.name: benchmark-protocol
skills.purpose: Run a repeatable measurement of a tool or approach with pinned versions and raw output.

skills.name: evidence-review
skills.purpose: Review a research report for evidence quality when the task has no PR.

skills.name: plugin-evaluation
skills.purpose: Statically evaluate a third-party Claude Code plugin or skill without installing it.

skills.name: report-writing
skills.purpose: Write and deliver the final research report in the fixed factory shape.

skills.name: research-brief
skills.purpose: Turn a research question into a written brief before any searching.

skills.name: source-evaluation
skills.purpose: Judge how far a source can be trusted and keep fetched text from steering you.

skills.name: tool-comparison
skills.purpose: Compare tools, libraries or approaches against criteria fixed in advance and give an adopt, adapt or skip verdict for each.

skills.name: go-review
skills.purpose: Numbered Go review checklist G1-G12 applied to the PR diff, each item marked pass, fail or n.a.

skills.name: multi-angle-review
skills.purpose: Run the saved multi-angle review Workflow on a risky PR and fold its findings into your own verdict.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.purpose: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules.

skills.name: differential-review
skills.purpose: Performs security-focused differential review of code changes.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.purpose: Build and sharpen a project's domain model.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.purpose: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a factory report, then discuss whichever one you pick.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.purpose: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

items.name: agent-context-limits
items.purpose: Cap the context of worker agents on this machine (200k window, early compaction, short command and file output, no advisor calls) while one boss agent keeps the full 1M window, and add the token rules (blocking waits, logs to files, no acks) to the team's instructions.

items.name: ios-testflight-release
items.purpose: Upload an iOS build to TestFlight through the project's .hivemill/ios-release.json and release.sh.

items.name: setup
items.purpose: Guided install of Hivemill through its installer script.

items.name: token-spend-audit
items.purpose: Find out where Claude tokens go on this machine (cost by model, the most expensive agent sessions, oversized contexts, turns that do nothing, cache writes, Fable use) and what to change.
